_about: Every sentence the report can say. hosting-snapshot-diff picks a template by fixed rules and fills {placeholders}. Edit wording here, never in code. Do not use em-dashes.
subject: Your hosting report for {monthYear}: {status}

headline.fixingOne: Your website is up, and I'm fixing one thing.
headline.fixingSeveral: Your website is up, and I'm fixing a few things.

sentence.upLow: it was up {uptime} of {month}, which is less than I like
sentence.slow: it loaded a little slower than I'd like
sentence.backupsAll: it was backed up every night
sentence.backupsSome: it was backed up {ok} of {total} nights

opener: I hope this email finds you well!

care.monitoring: watched your site around the clock
care.endRestoreTested: (I even test-restored one to make sure it works).

paymentFailed.title: {month}'s payment didn't go through
paymentFailed.body: Could you update your card when you get a minute? I'll send the link in a separate email. Your site stays up in the meantime.

domainManagedElsewhere.title: Your domain renews {date}
domainManagedElsewhere.body: {holder} manages it, so it's worth a quick check that it's set to auto-renew. Want me to check with them for you? Just reply and I'll take care of it.

uptime.title: Always on
uptime.captionLow: Your site was down {minutes} minutes this month. That's more than I like, and I'm working on it.
uptime.captionNone: Your site was up the whole month, so customers could find you any time.
uptime.captionOne: Your site was up all month except for {minutes} minutes on {monthShort} {day}.
uptime.captionOneNoDay: Your site was up all month except for {minutes} minutes.
uptime.captionMany: Your site was up all month except for {count} short blips ({minutes} minutes total).
uptime.alt: Bar chart of how often the site was up each month, {firstMonth} to {month}. {month} {value}{prevPart}.

speed.title: Fast on phones
speed.captionScore: Google scores your site {score} out of 100 for speed on phones{changePart}
speed.alt: Bar chart of Google's mobile speed score out of 100 each month. {month} {value}{prevPart}.

errors.captionNone: Visitors didn't run into a single error page this month, down from {prevCount} in {prevMonth}.
errors.captionSomeOne: {count} page load ran into an error this month. I'm tracking down why.
errors.captionSomeMany: {count} page loads ran into an error this month. I'm tracking down why.
errors.alt: Bar chart of error pages visitors hit each month. {month} {value}{prevPart}.

storage.title: Storage space
storage.captionOk: Your site is using {value} of its storage. Plenty of room, and I'm keeping an eye on it.
storage.captionLow: Your site is running low on storage. I'm cleaning it up so nothing slows down.
storage.alt: Bar chart of storage used each month. {month} {value}.

ssl.label: Security certificate
ssl.ok: Good through {date}. It renews on its own.

backups.label: Backups
backups.some: {ok} of {total} nights. I'm looking into the missed {ones}.

server.label: Server
server.lowDisk: Running low on space. I'm cleaning it up.
server.updated: Up to date with this month's security updates.
server.noUpdates: Up to date. No updates were due.

billing.label: Billing
billing.processing: {month}'s {amount} payment is on its way. Nothing to do.

close.question: Questions about your site or ideas for it? Just reply, it comes straight to me.
close.projectLine: Want something changed or added to your site? I take on projects too.
close.projectLinkText: Tell me what you have in mind
close.thanks: Thanks for letting me take care of it!

footer.reason: You're getting this because {domain} is hosted with me.
